issue.title: Prune ~15 one-off ovdNNN-* CI workflows and narrow Opus triggers to the sensitive list
issue.description:
From the graph review approved by Blaine (Oct 17, 2026), fix 4.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Inventory every `.github/workflows/ovd*-*.yml` (including ovd591-\* and the ovd7xx/8xx pending-pgtap jobs). For each one, record what it covers, whether it's a required check, and whether its issue is done.
2. Fold the live ones into the main suites, as a path-filtered matrix or a nightly job. Delete finished ones only after confirming nothing required depends on them.
3. Narrow the Opus review trigger to the sensitive classes and paths list (docs/sensitive-paths.json), not 'Jev risky' alone. Jev may still raise a tier, and that sends the PR to the Opus queue only if it's sensitive-class or a HIGH governance or security change (consistent with the [OVD-912](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-912/experiment-cross-family-reviewer-on-every-pr) pilot). Add a weekly Opus budget line, reported by the [OVD-894](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-894/lightweight-evals-weekly-report-on-pass-rate-and-cost-per-merged-pr) ledger.
4. Before and after: count CI minutes and workflow runs per PR over a week.
5. Any change to a required check goes as an exact diff on Blaine's card (through Grok Bot). Workflow-file edits otherwise follow the normal merge rule.

Owner: Engineer (Codex pool). Release confirms which checks are required. QA verifies that no coverage is lost. Jev triage first. Changing the Opus trigger is a gate change, so it needs Blaine's card.
